name: Color Picker
summary: Pick colors with HEX, RGB, and HSL controls — copy CSS values instantly in your browser.
description: Use a native color picker plus RGB and HSL sliders to explore a color. Copy HEX, rgb(), and hsl() values, and jump to complementary or analogous swatches. Everything runs locally.

faqs.question: Can I type a hex code?
faqs.answer: Yes. Paste #rgb or #rrggbb in the HEX field; the sliders and preview update when the value is valid.

faqs.question: What are related colors?
faqs.answer: Complementary is hue + 180°. Analogous swatches sit ±30° on the color wheel. Click a swatch to select it.

faqs.question: Is my color uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. All conversion and preview happen entirely in your browser.
